data.one_liner: A set of static analysis and linter rules to encourage good coding practices.
data.what_it_does: Provides a configurable set of analyzer and linting rules that can be included in a project's analysis_options.yaml file. It helps developers enforce consistent coding standards and catch potential issues early.
use_when: You want to enforce consistent coding practices across your Dart or Flutter project.
You want to customize static analysis and linter rules.
avoid_when: You prefer to write your own custom linter rule sets from scratch without any pre-defined base.
strengths: Easy to integrate via the include directive in analysis_options.yaml
Encourages good coding practices for applications, packages, and plugins
weaknesses: Limited documentation regarding the exact full list of rules enabled by default
data.setup_notes: Add analysis_options to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml and include package:analysis_options/analysis_options.yaml in your analysis_options.yaml file.

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Dart lint rules that provide a foundational set of recommendations.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Recommended lints for Flutter apps, packages, and plugins to catch potential bugs.

data.minimal_example:
dev_dependencies:
  analysis_options: any

# In analysis_options.yaml:
include: package:analysis_options/analysis_options.yaml
